svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-a-coat-female-honor-guard-flag-sling","name":"Women's Class A service dress coat: Honor Guard flag sling (white; the flag bearer's, worn instead of the pistol belt) (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-a-coat-female)","size_in":{"w":24.3883,"h":29.4756},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2438.83,2947.56],"size_source":"measured","size_basis":"Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1. Read from the Class A flag bearer figure of the Honor Guard guidance at the hardware scale (the figure's own 2 1/16 in pistol belt = 96 px, 46.5 px/in): waist band 1.66 in, shoulder straps 1.82 in across at 14.55 degrees from the vertical, cup 4.02 x 4.35 in with a 2.71 x 3.03 in nickel plate. Placed on the body by landmarks: the cup on the centre line, its top 0.67 in above the band's centre, the straps from 0.69 of the way from the centre line to the shoulder point (the figure: 239.5 px of 347 px) to the cup's top corners. Same box as garment-blues-class-a-coat-female.","provenance":"in-house vector. Measured on the Class A flag bearer figure of \"CAP Honor Guard Uniform Guidance\" (page 4, 6x render, crop origin 1850,2530): strap edges by row scans (left strap's white run 263..350 px at y 560 and 387..475 px at y 1040, right strap mirrored about the body centre line x 525), band 76.8 and 77.8 px of white (+3.2 px of outline) = 1.65 and 1.67 in, cup white 432..616 x 1062..1261 px (+outline 187 x 202 px = 4.02 x 4.35 in), nickel plate 461..584 x 1093..1231 px, slot outline 491..554 x 1131..1221 px. Height of the band: 0.318 of the way from button 2 to button 3 (figure 53.3 of 167.7 px), y 17.70 in on this sheet. The straps are cut where they go under the shoulder line (the coat's outline; a shoulder board drawn above hides the rest).
